note: Pins on ff-pin-1 beyond the Bitmark-era series manifest. All byte-verified on add except the Bitmark chain archive and HLS masters, which were pinned recursively from their existing CIDs (integrity guaranteed by the CID itself).

collections.description: Media of a2p (2019-2020), the artist-to-artist experiment Feral File grew out of. 144 works across two generations; archives at a2p.bitmark.com. Synced from the original storage and byte-verified 2026-08-03.

The retired Bitmark blockchain (2014-2025), preserved per github.com/bitmark-inc/bitmarkd/wiki/bitmark-archive: chain data on IPFS, Merkle root on Ethereum, timestamp on Bitcoin. Re-pinned on Feral File's archival node 2026-08-03.

HLS master playlists for 184 video works (FeralVerse, On Screen Presence) whose stream files were never placed on IPFS — the masters are preserved here; full video repackaging as directory CIDs is open remediation.

Rescue archive of Aorist, a digital-art initiative that ceased operating; Feral File migrated its collections in 2024 and stewards the works. Complete contents of the two surviving storage buckets — originals, renditions, video, and the two IPFS blockstores from the 2024 migration — restored from cold storage, synced, and byte-verified 2026-08-15. One CID per source prefix.
